sub: 360 panoramas and map photos at full resolution
hdri_pick_title: Turn any 360 panorama on your computer into an HDRI (for example one you have already retouched)
link_placeholder: Paste a link from the map application here (street view, 360 photo or photo)
hint_html: Open the panorama in the map application and copy the address from the browser's address bar, or use Share → Copy link. It also works for ordinary photos of places (the ones you cannot save with a right click). You can paste several at once.
north_title: Turns the image so its centre faces geographic north
json_title: Saves a .json file next to the image with coordinates, date, heading and author
nadir_title: Covers the tripod, the person or the car's smudge under the camera with a patch the colour of the ground. Saved with _nadir in the name.
fill_title: If a 360 photo does not cover the whole sphere, fills the missing sky and ground by stretching its edges to 2:1 (3ds Max needs it).
level_title: Corrects the camera's lean so the horizon is level and the verticals of buildings are vertical. Applies to the viewer, to crops and to downloads.
step1_html: In the map application, go into a street view or a user's blue 360 dot.
step2_html: Copy the link and paste it above. You will see the preview and the resolution.
step3_html: Press Download. You will get a 2:1 equirectangular image ready to edit and take to 3ds Max.
crop_tip: Frame by dragging · Wheel to zoom
crop_btn_title: Frame a part of the panorama and save it as a photo at full resolution
view_help: Drag to look around · Wheel to zoom
view_help_crop: Frame by dragging · Wheel to zoom · The crop comes out at the full resolution of the original
sun_click_title: Click where the sun is to place it by hand
see_sun_title: Lowers the exposure to check that the sun is strong enough
sun_strength_help: Direct sunlight compared with skylight. Clear 4–8 · Haze 1–3 · Overcast 0.
sun_size_help: Smaller, sharper shadows; larger, softer ones.
highlights_help: Gives back the brightness of clouds, sky and reflections that the JPG had flattened.
resolution_help: 4K–8K is enough for lighting. Use the 16K JPG for a sharp background.
crop_title: Frame a part and save it as a photo at full resolution
hdri_card_title: Turn this panorama into an HDRI to light with in 3ds Max
again_title: Download again with the current options (e.g. another format)
partial_title: This 360 photo does not cover the whole sphere (it is not 2:1). In 3ds Max it will look stretched if you use it as a spherical environment.
no_viewer: This computer cannot show the 360 viewer.
wait_hdri: Wait for it to finish or cancel the conversion.
info_no_sun: No sun: only the sky and highlights are boosted.
below_horizon: it is below the horizon, it gives no light
sun_not_seen: I cannot see the sun (overcast or hidden). If it is there, click on it in the image.
